text:
nina: Noticed duplicates from sampleapp during a short spike. Looks like token-rotation + retry alignment again. Repro locally with 50 parallel onboarding requests.
raj: Do we have a trace?
nina: Short trace: `REQ id=onb_202 status=429 refresh_start=true retry=1` then a separate connection `REQ id=onb_202 status=200 action=applied` ~180ms later. Sampleapp doesn't set Idempotency by default.
paul: That's been our recurring class of bugs. Two quick mitigations: (1) converge SDK backoff defaults so different runtimes don't line up; (2) sampleapp should create and attach an `Idempotency-Key` per user-flow by default (opt-out).
raj: For backoff convergence can we pick a named profile that maps cleanly across languages (so clients can set `profile: "resilient-2026"`)? Proposal:
```
profile: "resilient-2026"
resilient-2026:
  attempts: "6"
  base_ms: "100"
  max_ms: "1800"
  algorithm: "decorrelated-jitter"
  token_refresh_guard: "enabled"
```
paul: +1 on the guard. Implementation suggestion: SDKs track an in-flight refresh token promise and delay retries that detect `auth_refresh_in_progress` by a small randomized backoff (e.g. rand(0, min(backoff, 250ms))). That prevents thundering after refresh completes.
nina: Can we also auto-generate Idempotency keys in the sampleapp using `Idempotency-Key: sampleapp-<flow_id>-<rand>` and persist it on the client until completion? Make it toggled with SAMPLEAPP_IDEMPOTENCY=on/off.
raj: Tests: add an integration scenario with short-lived tokens (TTL 1s) and assert zero duplicate side-effects under 100-parallel runs. Also add unit tests that the refresh guard defers retries while refresh is ongoing (mocked).
paul: Telemetry: add counters `retries.total`, `retries.after_refresh`, `side_effects.duplicate_count` so we can alert if duplicates reappear. Create a Grafana alert at 0.25% over 10m.
ops-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-common/issues/501 (spec for resilient-2026 profile and refresh-guard).
nina: I'll own the sampleapp change and the onboarding doc blurb explaining why we set Idempotency-Key. raj: I'll implement the SDK profile and refresh-guard across node/python/go (will open PRs). paul: I'll wire telemetry + alerts.
raj: One compatibility note: we'll gate the new profile behind env `RW_RETRY_PROFILE=resilient-2026` initially and flip the default after one minor release to avoid surprising CI that depends on deterministic timings. We'll document how to opt back into `legacy` behavior.
paul: Good. Also add a tiny helper in SDKs `sdk.autoIdempotency()` that returns a stable key for a flow; docs should note when not to use it (e.g., truly non-idempotent ops).
nina: Plan: ship sampleapp patch today, SDK PRs tomorrow, deploy to staging for a 24h canary, then flip default in next release if telemetry stable.
raj: Sounds like a plan. Thanks team :thumbsup:
